hook: 5 stars doesn't mean what you think
youtube_title: Bharat NCAP 5 star rating explained: what it really means

slides.heading: 5 stars doesn't mean what you think
There are two ratings, not one
The rating is for the variant tested

voice_lines: Bharat NCAP gives two ratings: adult protection, out of thirty two points, and child protection, out of forty nine. Check both.
The main frontal crash is at sixty four kilometres per hour. That's not a highway speed crash, so drive accordingly.
And the rating is for the variant they tested. Check that your variant has the same airbags and E S C.
Stars help, but seat belts save lives, in the rear seat too. Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram.
caption:
A 5-star Bharat NCAP rating is great, but read it properly ⭐

• Two ratings: Adult Occupant (out of 32) and Child Occupant (out of 49). Check both.
• The frontal offset test is at 64 km/h, not highway speed.
• The rating applies to the variant tested. Make sure yours has the same airbags and ESC.

Stars help, seat belts save. Rear passengers too.

Any doubts? Comment below or DM me on Instagram 👇
